claim: On December 1, 2024 Amazon EKS added EKS Auto Mode, which fully automates Kubernetes cluster infrastructure management for compute, storage, and networking on AWS.
question: When did EKS Auto Mode become available, and what does it automate?
note: Before Auto Mode the answer for less node management was managed node groups or self-run Karpenter. Karpenter autoscaler support has its own history row of 2021-11-29.
